behaviour.animations: panel heroBodyAnimate .4s ease (opacity 0->1, translateX 10%->0) at >=640; h1 text reveal slideIn .5s ease, delay .5s (translateY 100%->0 in an overflow-hidden mask); intro slideInLeft .9s ease, delay 1.2s (opacity + translateX 10%->0) at >=768, slideInFromBottom (translateY 10%->0) below. CSS-only, run once on load; add prefers-reduced-motion.
behaviour.layout: >=640 image absolute left (7/12 sm, 2/3 lg) + panel right (6/12 sm, 5/12 lg) with clip-path circle(800px at 800px 50%); <640 stacked, panel -15% overlap, clip-path circle(600px at 50% 600px), centred text.

visualCharacteristics.purpose: Page-opening hero: photo left, red gradient panel with a curved edge right, h1 + intro with CSS load animations

contentPattern.structure: row 1: image (+ alt); row 2: rich text with h1 and intro paragraph

usage: First section of the mybeckman.in home page.
reuseGuidance: Use for a page-opening photo + headline + intro on mybeckman.in-styled pages. Not for /en/ beckmancoulter.com pages (use hero).
